section_title: 2.1. Agroforestry Model: Bakain (Melia azedarach) based Agri-silvicultural System
summary: This document describes an agri-silvicultural system based on Melia azedarach (Bakain) suitable for arid and dry regions, particularly in Telangana, India. The system integrates timber production with food crops like foxtail millet, providing economic returns for small and marginal landholders.

heading_path: 2.1. Agroforestry Model: Bakain (Melia azedarach) based Agri-silvicultural System
passages.text: Melia azedarach is a small to medium, deciduous tree from 6 to 35 m in height. The bark is brown, narrow which gives a striped appearance It tolerates a wide range of climate and soil conditions. Young trees are vulnerable to high temperature. It is a drought resistant tree.

heading_path: 2.1. Agroforestry Model: Bakain (Melia azedarach) based Agri-silvicultural System
passages.text: The tree is propagated through seed. The land should ploughed and well levelled before digging pits of size 45 cm x 45 cm x 45 cm. The following spacing may be used: bund 3 m, boundary 3 m, and block 4 m x 4 m. FYM@ 5t/ha and 60:60:40 NPK/ha should be applied at the time of planting. For tending side branches should be removed.

heading_path: 2.1. Agroforestry Model: Bakain (Melia azedarach) based Agri-silvicultural System
passages.text: About 30.5 t/ha (crop + tree) biomass products; inter-crop yield: 1.8 -2.0 t/ha

heading_path: 2.1. Agroforestry Model: Bakain (Melia azedarach) based Agri-silvicultural System
passages.text: Environmental Benefits: High carbon assimilation by tree + crop combination.

heading_path: 2.1. Agroforestry Model: Bakain (Melia azedarach) based Agri-silvicultural System
passages.text: The technology is suitable for arid and dry regions in Telangana where arable crops are not profitable. This system will give both timber and food crops from the same piece of land.
